sourceType.description: The type of the input file

state.description: The expected status(for the root sources) after transforming and persisting

stats.description: The expected stats (for the root sources) after transforming and persisting

errors.description: The expected errors after transforming and persisting (represented as a regular expression)

failedSourcesBySources.description: A map from a source instance id to a string of errors (represented as a regular expression)

errorCountBySources.description: A map from a source instance id to the number of expected errors

sourceStatus.description:
A map from source type to the stats for the source. If needed, another map from sourcesId to stats may also be
added to the test for specific paths in the transformation DAG.

transformStatus.description:
A map from transform type name to the stats for the transform. If needed, another map from transformId to Stats
may also be added to test for specific paths in transformation DAG.

targetStatus.description:
A map from the {see Persistable} type name to the stats. If needed, another map from persistableId to stats may
also be added to test for specific paths in the transformation DAG.
